how_it_works: The model declares fields with descriptions and a `__template__`. SLDB uses the template markers to map between Markdown structure and typed field values. Optional semantics attach higher-level concepts to the model.
title: StructuredNLDoc Model
what_it_is: A `StructuredNLDoc` model is the Pydantic-based contract that tells SLDB how to render Markdown, extract typed payload data from Markdown, and validate roundtrip behavior.
when_it_shows_up: You encounter it when creating a new model, registering one, validating idempotency, rendering docs, extracting payloads, or querying tracked docs.
where_it_lives: It lives in Python code. Common examples are app-local docs modules and this repo's `docs/models.py`.
who_uses_it: Model authors, CLI users, and automation all rely on the `StructuredNLDoc` contract whenever Markdown must remain human-readable while still being machine-structured.
why_it_matters: It is the contract boundary that turns free-form Markdown into a typed document workflow instead of an unstructured text file.
